get.summary: Get auditable ingredient evidence and research citations
get.description:
Retrieve cached ingredient evidence with strict epistemic separation and citation metadata.

Never triggers external network requests on ordinary GET calls. Separates:
- `identity_references` (CosIng nomenclature/functions/restrictions)
- `published_research` (PubMed bibliographic metadata & abstracts, `has_full_text=False`)
- `human_interpretations` (authored/reviewed evidence summaries with provenance)
- `marketing_claims` (segregated commercial claims, never treated as scientific proof)

post.summary: Generate a grounded skincare explanation backed by retrieved evidence
post.description:
Generate a grounded, non-diagnostic explanation for products and ingredients.

Enforces:
- Per-user sliding-window rate limits (`AI_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE`).
- Strict request size validation (`schema_version="1.0"`).
- Source-ID grounding verification against PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch records.
- Prompt injection isolation for untrusted product descriptions and OCR text.
- Deterministic safe fallback if model output contains unsupported citations or claims.

RoutineUpdateRequest.title: RoutineUpdateRequest
RoutineUpdateRequest.description: Request payload for updating a skincare routine and/or replacing its steps.

source_ids.title: Source Ids
source_ids.description: Traceable source IDs (prod:<uuid>, ing:<uuid>, ev:<uuid>, res:<uuid>).

RuleEvaluationItem.title: RuleEvaluationItem
RuleEvaluationItem.description: Single explainable, versioned rule evaluation in the recommendation engine.

epistemic_disclaimer.title: Epistemic Disclaimer
epistemic_disclaimer.default: User-reported observation only. Recording a reaction does not prove that a product or ingredient caused a symptom and is never a medical or clinical diagnosis of an allergic reaction or contact dermatitis.

SafetyAwareReactionResponse.title: SafetyAwareReactionResponse
SafetyAwareReactionResponse.description: Serialized product reaction with non-diagnostic disclaimer and urgent-care guidance.

general_disclaimer.title: General Disclaimer
general_disclaimer.default: ToneTrace AI is an educational skincare companion, not a medical or diagnostic service. Explanations summarize general ingredient reference data and product-label findings without diagnosing conditions, inferring cause from scans, or guaranteeing outcomes.

SafetyEscalationNotice.title: SafetyEscalationNotice
SafetyEscalationNotice.description: Mandatory non-diagnostic safety boundary and symptom escalation notice.

signed_view_url.title: Signed View Url
signed_view_url.description: Short-lived HMAC-signed private endpoint to view the image; None if deleted.

ScanMediaResponse.title: ScanMediaResponse
ScanMediaResponse.description: Metadata and short-lived private view link for a scan media object.

SearchFacetBucket.title: SearchFacetBucket
SearchFacetBucket.description: Single aggregation term and document count.

identity_reference.title: Identity Reference
identity_reference.description: 1. Official ingredient identity & regulatory reference info (CosIng)

marketing_claims.title: Marketing Claims
marketing_claims.description: 4. Product marketing claims (strictly isolated from scientific evidence)

SeparatedEvidenceGroups.title: SeparatedEvidenceGroups
SeparatedEvidenceGroups.description: Explicit 4-way separation of identity, published research, human review, and marketing.

product_id.title: Product Id
product_id.description: Public catalogue Product UUID when adding a catalogue-linked item.

ocr_job_id.title: Ocr Job Id
ocr_job_id.description: Optional user-owned OCRJob UUID for custom scanned products.

custom_name.title: Custom Name
custom_name.description: Custom product name (required when product_id is omitted).

custom_brand.title: Custom Brand
custom_brand.description: Custom brand name (required when product_id is omitted).

custom_category.title: Custom Category
custom_category.description: Skincare category for custom product (e.g. cleanser, serum, sunscreen).

custom_ingredient_text.title: Custom Ingredient Text
custom_ingredient_text.description: Optional raw ingredient declaration for a custom product.

opened_at.title: Opened At
opened_at.description: Optional date/time when the product was opened.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: Optional expiration or Period-After-Opening target date.

purchase_price_minor_units.title: Purchase Price Minor Units
purchase_price_minor_units.description: Optional purchase price in integer minor units (e.g. cents).

purchase_currency.title: Purchase Currency
purchase_currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP).

private_notes.title: Private Notes
private_notes.description: Personal notes kept strictly private to the owning user.

initial_reaction.description: Optional initial reaction or tolerance observation.

ShelfItemCreateRequest.title: ShelfItemCreateRequest
ShelfItemCreateRequest.description: Request payload to add a catalogue-linked or custom product to My Shelf.

sensitivity_alerts.title: Sensitivity Alerts
sensitivity_alerts.description: Ingredients in this item that match the user's known sensitivities.

incomplete_ingredient_warning.title: Incomplete Ingredient Warning
incomplete_ingredient_warning.description: Explicit warning when ingredient data is missing or unparsed.

ShelfItemResponse.title: ShelfItemResponse
ShelfItemResponse.description: User-owned shelf item with resolved catalogue/custom details and sensitivity flags.

reaction.description: Optional reaction or tolerance observation to append to this shelf item.

ShelfItemUpdateRequest.title: ShelfItemUpdateRequest
ShelfItemUpdateRequest.description: PATCH payload for updating a user's shelf item or recording a product reaction.

ShelfListResponse.title: ShelfListResponse
ShelfListResponse.description: Paginated response of user shelf items.

SkinJournalEntryResponse.title: SkinJournalEntryResponse
SkinJournalEntryResponse.description: Response model for a user skin story journal entry.

SkinJournalListResponse.title: SkinJournalListResponse
SkinJournalListResponse.description: Paginated list of user skin story journal entries.

net_observed_delta.title: Net Observed Delta
net_observed_delta.description: Numeric difference (latest_display_value - earliest_comparable_display_value). Explicitly None if fewer than 2 comparable observations exist.

observation_classification.title: Observation Classification
observation_classification.description: Strictly descriptive visual metric change category; never framed as clinical improvement or medical regression.

non_clinical_interpretation.title: Non Clinical Interpretation
non_clinical_interpretation.description: Clear explanation distinguishing observed visual score shifts from clinical improvement and noting capture condition sensitivity.

compatibility_warnings.title: Compatibility Warnings
compatibility_warnings.description: Warnings when historical scans used different providers, models, or units.

SkinMetricTimeline.title: SkinMetricTimeline
SkinMetricTimeline.description: Longitudinal history and compatibility-checked delta for a single normalized metric.

SkinObservationResponse.title: SkinObservationResponse
SkinObservationResponse.description: Normalized single-metric visual observation from a skin scan.

skin_type.title: Skin Type
skin_type.description: dry, oily, combination, normal, or sensitive

SkinScanDeleteResponse.title: SkinScanDeleteResponse
SkinScanDeleteResponse.description: Confirmation of scan and private media deletion.

SkinScanListResponse.title: SkinScanListResponse
SkinScanListResponse.description: Paginated list of user skin scans.

non_diagnostic_disclaimer.title: Non Diagnostic Disclaimer
non_diagnostic_disclaimer.default: Visual surface observations are derived from 2D photographs for cosmetic tracking only. They do not infer the underlying cause of pigmentation, do not diagnose any dermatological or medical condition, and do not substitute for an in-person clinical evaluation.

variability_disclosure.title: Variability Disclosure
variability_disclosure.default: Lighting intensity and color temperature, camera lens and sensor preprocessing, viewing angle, facial expression, and cosmetics or skincare residue can significantly affect visual surface measurements across scans.

SkinScanResponse.title: SkinScanResponse
SkinScanResponse.description: Full skin scan representation with provenance, status, and normalized observations.

is_comparable_to_baseline.title: Is Comparable To Baseline
is_comparable_to_baseline.description: True only if unit, provider_name, provider_model_version, and interpretation_version match the timeline baseline.

incompatibility_reason.title: Incompatibility Reason
incompatibility_reason.description: Explicit explanation if this point cannot be directly compared to baseline.

SkinStoryPoint.title: SkinStoryPoint
SkinStoryPoint.description: Single historical data point in a metric's longitudinal timeline.

capture_variability_notice.title: Capture Variability Notice
capture_variability_notice.default: Lighting intensity and color temperature, camera lens and sensor preprocessing, viewing angle, facial expression, and cosmetics or skincare residue can significantly affect visual surface measurements across scans.

non_diagnostic_disclaimer.title: Non Diagnostic Disclaimer
non_diagnostic_disclaimer.default: Visual surface observations are derived from 2D photographs for cosmetic tracking only. They do not infer the underlying cause of pigmentation, do not diagnose any dermatological or medical condition, and do not substitute for an in-person clinical evaluation.

pigmentation_and_causation_guardrail.title: Pigmentation And Causation Guardrail
pigmentation_and_causation_guardrail.default: ToneTrace AI reports only surface-level visual appearance metrics and user-authored journal reflections. It never infers the biological or medical cause of pigmentation (such as melasma, post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation, solar lentigines, or dermatoses) and never fabricates missing historical observations.

SkinStoryResponse.title: SkinStoryResponse
SkinStoryResponse.description: Longitudinal Skin Story combining compatible visual observations and user journal history.

entity_uuid.title: Entity Uuid
entity_uuid.description: Database primary key UUID of the record.

external_id.title: External Id
external_id.description: External identifier such as PMID, CosIng Ref No, or EAN barcode.

source_url.title: Source Url
source_url.description: Authoritative permalink to the upstream record when available.

epistemic_category.title: Epistemic Category
epistemic_category.description: Evidence category when applicable (identity_reference, published_research, etc.).

has_full_text.title: Has Full Text
has_full_text.description: Explicitly False when only bibliographic metadata or abstract is available.

retrieved_at.title: Retrieved At
retrieved_at.description: UTC timestamp when this record was retrieved.

SourceReferenceItem.title: SourceReferenceItem
SourceReferenceItem.description: Authoritative provenance record for a retrieved source in the grounding context.

user_product_id.title: User Product Id
user_product_id.description: Optional shelf item ID (must belong to the authenticated user)

routine_id.title: Routine Id
routine_id.description: Optional routine ID during which the reaction was observed

reaction_type.title: Reaction Type
reaction_type.description: Reaction category: well_tolerated, irritation, redness, breakout, dryness, stinging, allergic_suspect, no_visible_change

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: Perceived severity: none, mild, moderate, severe

symptoms.title: Symptoms
symptoms.description: Reported symptoms (e.g. redness, burning, swelling, hives, blistering)

is_rapidly_worsening.title: Is Rapidly Worsening
is_rapidly_worsening.description: True if the user reports that the reaction is rapidly worsening or spreading

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Private user notes describing the reaction context

observed_at.title: Observed At
observed_at.description: Optional UTC timestamp when reaction was observed (defaults to now)

TokenResponse.title: TokenResponse
TokenResponse.description: Tokens returned upon successful authentication or rotation.

missing_concentrations_noted.title: Missing Concentrations Noted
missing_concentrations_noted.description: True when exact ingredient percentage concentrations are unknown.

abstract_only_research_noted.title: Abstract Only Research Noted
abstract_only_research_noted.description: True when cited literature records consist of metadata/abstracts only.

conflicting_or_limited_evidence_noted.title: Conflicting Or Limited Evidence Noted
conflicting_or_limited_evidence_noted.description: True when retrieved evidence is preliminary, limited, or conflicting.

untrusted_label_or_ocr_noted.title: Untrusted Label Or Ocr Noted
untrusted_label_or_ocr_noted.description: True when untrusted product descriptions, marketing claims, or OCR text were present.

UncertaintyDisclosure.title: UncertaintyDisclosure
UncertaintyDisclosure.description: Structured disclosure of epistemic limitations and unknown variables.

UpdateEvidenceReviewRequest.title: UpdateEvidenceReviewRequest
UpdateEvidenceReviewRequest.description: Payload to transition the review status of an IngredientEvidence record.

is_granted.title: Is Granted
is_granted.description: True to grant, False to revoke consent

UserConsentUpdateRequest.title: UserConsentUpdateRequest
UserConsentUpdateRequest.description: Payload to grant or revoke consent for a given purpose.

device_label.title: Device Label
device_label.description: Optional client description or device name

UserPreferencesResponse.title: UserPreferencesResponse
UserPreferencesResponse.description: User product, routine, and notification preferences.

UserProfileUpdateRequest.title: UserProfileUpdateRequest
UserProfileUpdateRequest.description: Partial update payload for user profile.

password.title: Password
password.description: Plaintext password meeting minimum length requirement

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: Public display name for profile creation

UserResponse.title: UserResponse
UserResponse.description: Safe public representation of a user entity (never leaks password or tokens).

UserSensitivityCreateRequest.title: UserSensitivityCreateRequest
UserSensitivityCreateRequest.description: Payload to add a cosmetic ingredient sensitivity.
